purpose: Find narrow entry wedges where branded short-form commentary, owned utility/state, and clean personalization reinforce each other.

signals: Social discovery remains a major beauty discovery and consideration channel.
AI-assisted beauty shopping is rising, but trust, proof and transparency matter.
Social commerce already converts meaningful beauty demand, making short-form discovery commercially relevant.
The crowded field means generic recommendation or virtual try-on alone is not a moat.
candidate_wedges: routine simplification for users overwhelmed by too many products

signals: AI wardrobe digitization and outfit recommendation are already active categories.
Shareable looks create a natural social return loop.
The strongest owned-state asset is the user's actual wardrobe plus occasion history, not generic styling advice.
candidate_wedges: trend criticism translated into outfits using clothes the user already owns
creator trend decode to personal closet action

signals: Progress history, goals and training state create durable first-party value.
Generic AI coaching is commoditizing, so the wedge must be behavior/state-specific.
Shareable progress can naturally return value to social discovery.
candidate_wedges: short-form exercise trend verification plus progression state
creator workout challenge converted into a safe personal progression plan
micro-habit adherence with visible streak and progression history

signals: General AI can answer questions cheaply, so generic tutoring has low defensibility.
Durable value comes from skill-state, spaced practice, mistake history and measurable progression.
Short-form creator content can create discovery, but owned practice must do something the clip cannot.
candidate_wedges: trend explainer to five-minute active practice
creator lesson converted into personalized drills and recall schedule

signals: Gear reviews and trend commentary fit character-led social content well.
Purchase-only models are weak for retention; pairing gear decisions with progression records creates a stronger loop.
Affiliate potential exists but must not replace genuine owned utility.
candidate_wedges: beginner gear decision plus progress journal
trend product critique translated into user-specific buy-or-skip decision
skill milestone unlocks the next equipment recommendation

current_shortlist.wedge: fashion: creator trend decode -> outfits from the user's actual closet
current_shortlist.why: High character/video fit, strong shareable output, recurring occasion intent, useful owned wardrobe state, commerce monetization without requiring high-risk claims.
current_shortlist.key_risk: AI styling and wardrobe apps already exist; differentiation must be trend commentary plus personal closet execution, not generic outfit generation.

current_shortlist.wedge: fitness: trend workout verification -> personal progression state
current_shortlist.why: Strong repeat intent and state accumulation; content-to-action loop is natural; progress is shareable.
current_shortlist.key_risk: Crowded fitness market and safety burden; generic AI coach is insufficient.

current_shortlist.wedge: beauty: trending product/claim critique -> routine simplification and personal fit
current_shortlist.why: Very strong social discovery and purchase intent, high character-review fit, high commerce upside.
current_shortlist.key_risk: Crowded market, trust requirements and health-adjacent claim risk require conservative positioning.

current_shortlist.wedge: learning: creator explainer -> personalized active practice and mistake memory
current_shortlist.why: Excellent recurring state and subscription fit; low physical safety risk.
current_shortlist.key_risk: Generic AI substitution is strong, so the moat must be long-term learner state and deliberate practice.

current_shortlist.wedge: hobby gear: trend critique -> buy/skip plus skill progression
current_shortlist.why: Natural character-led reviews and affiliate/commerce fit; can expand across many hobbies.
current_shortlist.key_risk: Retention is weak if progression tooling is shallow and the service becomes only a comparison site.

selection_rule: Do not choose a winner from desk research alone. Advance only after competitor mapping, general-AI substitution test, policy/safety review, monetization model and a frozen pre-test forecast are complete.
